# Roboto

The website bundles a Cyrillic/Latin subset of the Roboto variable font so the
HTML startup shell and Compose use identical sans-serif metrics on every host.

- Source: `Roboto[wdth,wght].ttf` from the Google Fonts `ofl/roboto` directory
- Source SHA-256: `d7598d49d96f67b0e7ecff22903fa64ec609d8c2268b5f747c49e37219d79ff7`
- Subset Unicode ranges: `U+0000-00FF,U+0400-052F`
- Bundled SHA-256: `f99820f9f1c7c17128e10983e7d56d183e666a1fa291ceb2670b7b09c75da106`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (`OFL.txt`)

The subset was generated with fonttools `pyftsubset`, retaining all layout
features, variation axes, and font name records.
